_documentation: host.json -- PER-MACHINE config: NIC, network, timing, services, foreground keeper, GPIO. Travels with the controlling computer, NOT the rig. On the Windows/Qt build the desktop app owns this file (read-only in the web UI); on a headless build the web UI owns it. Copy any line into your live host.json to override the compiled-in default. Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation-only and ignored by the parser. See Docs/CONFIG_REFERENCE.md for descriptions and units.
_section_network: EtherCAT NIC + telemetry + web UI. telemetryBindAddr: 127.0.0.1 suits same-PC telemetry (Windows); a NUC sets its LAN IP or 0.0.0.0; Linux/Pi auto-corrects loopback to all-interfaces; dedicated-NUC setups see NUC_DEPLOYMENT.md. webAllowedHosts: extra Host-header names beyond the machine's own (localhost/hostname/interface addresses are always accepted). tempPollSec: IGBT temp poll period, 0 disables (Windows default 0). dcPhaseLock*: dormant compensator, keep disabled unless rig-validated. webUIEnabled defaults false on the Qt build; set true to expose the dashboard at webBindAddr:webPort. webShowDevices shows the web Devices section (force devices: shifter/pedal; Pi builds).
_section_logging: Log-level + DIAG toggles. logMinLevel: debug|info|warning|error|critical. diagEnabled gates the DIAG stream. simulationMode runs the engine with no hardware.
_section_init: EtherCAT init/bus reliability knobs -- master behaviour on THIS machine. enableCapabilityScan runs 24+ SDO reads per drive (first-time setup only). commandSyncCycles holds CW=0x07 before 0x0F at enable. wkcValidation* gate the post-OP working-counter check.
_section_foregroundKeeper: Windows-only background-throttling defense (1x1 topmost window). Ignored on Linux.
_section_gpio: Pi appliance GPIO control panel. Ignored on the PC build. gpioMode: off|estop|estop_led|full. Pins are BCM line numbers on gpioChip; any BUTTON pin set to 0 is not fitted (wire any subset). Buttons: engage=RUN (init/start/stop), park, belt (slack/tension), device (home/engage/release).
